question: Which among the following is the largest unit of memory of a computer system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yottabyte**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **Yottabyte **is **a measure of computer storage capacity**.
 
• It **equals approximately **a **trillion bytes**. Mostly the storage capacity of large storage devices is **measured in YottaBytes**.
 
• In **computer systems**, a **unit of data **that is **eight binary digits **long is **known as a byte**.
 
• The **kilobyte **is **the smallest unit **of **memory measurement **but greater **than a byte**.
 
• **A kilobyte is 103 **or **1,000 bytes abbreviated as ‘KB**’.
 
• **A megabyte **(MB) is **a data measurement **unit applied to **a digital computer **or **media storage**.
 
• **One MB equals **one **million (106 or 1,000,000) bytes**.
 
• **GB **stands for **"gigabyte".**
 
• **" A gigabyte is 1 billion bytes**.
 
• **A gigabyte **is a **measurement of data storage **for **computers**, **tablets**, **smartphones**, **gaming consoles**, and other computing devices.
 
• A **terabyte **is **more precisely **defined as **1,024 gigabytes (GB).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Computer Storage measured in**:

 
 
• 1 YB (Yottabyte) = 1024 TB
 
• 1 TB (Terabytes) = 1024 GB
 
• 1 GB (Gigabytes) = 1024 MB
 
• 1 Mb (Megabytes) = 1024KB
 
• 1 KB (Kilobytes) = 1024 byte
